subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

89, 84, 82, 79, 75, 74, 68, ?
solution:
**The pattern followed here is : **

 
• **Starting with the first number in the series (7) is subtracted alternately.**
 
• **Starting with the second number in the series (5) is subtracted alternately.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a2b629fc7b49b54b4f1d5b0a61175421ce7668939f1184fa6e93fcb0bedf91.png] 

Hence, **"69"** is the correct answer.
